name: @extas/support
description: The support core (S22, PR 425; Blueprint B4.4): conversations and their messages from every channel, threads with files, internal notes the customer never sees, taking and giving a conversation to an employee, open / waiting / solved, and the who-did-what log (append-only). Channels plug in through an adapter (PR 426); until one is connected a reply is kept and marked not sent.
